bobsweep - ultravision pet self-empty ro.description: Shed happens! And when it does, UltraVision Pet Combo is your best friend. With 25,000Pa suction, DualScrub auto-lift mops, a 180-day auto-empty dock, activated-charcoal-lined dust bags, and a high-resolution object-detection camera, this bot is the heavy lifter that provides the best relief for pet owners who love their pets but not their mess. The extra-large 6 L (1.5 gal) dust bags hold pet hair, dust, dander, litter, and stray kibble that furry family members leave behind — making UltraVision Pet Combo ideal for homes with pets and high-traffic areas. The disposable bags are reinforced with activated charcoal to neutralize odors, so there’s no stinky dock in your home. Each bot includes two bags, and refills are economical and easy to replace. Powered by bObsweep’s proprietary QSLAM navigation software, UltraVision Pet Combo scans and maps your space in real time, navigating under and around furniture with precision. As he moves, the bot builds a detailed floor map that you can customize, save, and edit in the bObsweep mobile app. Maps are stored only locally on the bot, and multi-storey floor maps are supported. Above all, with UltraVision Pet Combo you can rest assured about your home’s privacy. bObsweep bots are engineered never to send images of your home anywhere—and the hardware architecture precludes transmitting data-heavy content such as images or videos from the device. bObsweep builds privacy into the design, protecting you against breaches.

ufc fusion by venum fight week men’s pan.description: Introduciendo UFC Fusion por Venum, una gama completa de ropa y accesorios que fusiona tejidos de rendimiento sofisticados con elementos de diseño primario. Fabricado con tejidos de rendimiento duraderos y transpirables y telas de estilo de vida premium, esta gama completa de prendas permite a los atletas navegar tanto sesiones de entrenamiento como días de descanso en comodidad. El UFC Fusion by Venum Fight Week Men’s Pant cuenta con bolsillos laterales con cremallera y una cintura de cordón. Hecho con una tela de estiramiento premium, estos pantalones se mueven contigo - perfecto para todos los atletas en marcha. Esta colorida negra/oro está reservada para los campeones UFC.
